title: EAP: Fix Dead Store
description: Fix dead store (Dead assignement/Dead increment) Warning found by Clang

notes.body: Hi @mikaelkanstrup can you check ?

These warnings I suppose are seen because of updating the offset var at end of functions without then using it. Returning offset and then ignoring the return value should be OK. However wouldn't it be good to also modify the other functions already returning an integer. The existing ones return the size dissected rather than offset. For clarity all functions should handle return values in a similar manner. 

See functions dissect_eap_psk_pchannel, dissect_eap_sake_attribute, dissect_eap_gpsk_csuite_list, dissect_eap_gpsk_csuite_sel.
